input_domain: Variable-arity debug calls in the recorded valid resource domain.
compared_effects: Diagnostic call marker only; no formatting/output claim.
limitations: Canonical WinPrintf is an empty RETF. Return is ignored at these call sites. The hook does not capture complete variadic arguments and is not formatting proof.
